brief: Inspect intake and exhaust louvres for blockage exceeding one quarter of the free area and clear any obstruction before the heat event [SOP-015]. Because this unit has ONAN cooling [Willow Vale asset facts], the forced cooling de-rating rules in MG-021 do not apply; however, for this 49-year-old unit [Willow Vale asset facts], apply the loading restrictions in MG-021 if pre-event attention is not possible [MG-023].
